Click a header to sort. Click a row to filter (Ctrl/⌘-click to add). Selected rows stay highlighted against their peers.
Witness, Waive and Scheduled are the Event Status values; Pass, Fail and Inconclusive are the Test Result values, all as written in the spreadsheet. Witness % and Waive % are shares of all events in the row. Fail % = Fail ÷ (Pass + Fail + Inconclusive), i.e. among rows with a non-blank Test Result. “(blank)” marks an empty cell in the spreadsheet.
